name: Measured Joules, Learned Routes: Learning to Route for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving (arXiv 2609.23085)
notes: arXiv comment '16 pages, 10 figures, in submission' — i.e. NOT accepted anywhere as of this record; venue is arXiv-preprint. Trained router (SFT then GRPO) over an offline tournament profiling correctness, latency, power and GPU energy. Authors: Muhammad Abdur Rab Siddiqui, Daniela Rojas, Chen Yang, Wenqi Cui, Yuanyuan Shi, Yize Chen.
